item.title: Résumé
item.description:
• Internships

    • LLVM (Low-Level Virtual Machine) Intern - Google Summer of Code (Nov 2024 - Present)
      • Currently working on modernizing the LLVM Website under the leadership of Prof. Vassil Vaasilev (Princeton University).

  • School Clubs And Roles

    • Team Lead, Technology Student Association (TSA) TEAMS Competition, Engineering Club (2025)
      • My team, 6950-HS-C, represented Westwood High School in the National TSA TEAMS competition and was ranked Top 20 nationally in the Presentation category.
    • Team Lead, The American Rocketry Challenge (TARC) Team, Engineering Club (2024-Present)
      • Developed team strategies and led the team to success in the February 2025, March 2025, and April 2025 TARC-organized launches.
    • Build and CAD, Orange Dynamite 2583 FRC, Robotics Club (2023-Present)
      • Helped build and CAD a robot that advanced to the States competition and won the Engineering Inspiration Award at Victoria, Texas (2025)
    • Lead CAD, Arrowhead FTC, Robotics Club (2022-2023)
      • CAD Lead for FTC team ‘Arrowhead’ and participated in multiple regional competitions.
    • President and Founder, Web Development Club (2025)
      • Created a Web Development Club at Westwood High School to teach people HUGO, HTML, and CSS, and encouraged participation in multiple competitions.

  • Extracurricular Activities

item.title: About
item.description:
Hey there! I’m Pranav Kalpathi Shankar, a high school student at Westwood High School and an aspiring aerospace engineer with a passion for bringing ambitious ideas to life through engineering, leadership, and design.

From 2024 to 2026, I led our TARC (Team America Rocketry Challenge) team, guiding us through every phase from concept to launch. I also served as the Team Lead for our Technology Student Association team, where I helped us qualify for the national competition in Nashville. On the robotics side, I was the CAD Lead for FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) Team 17264 ‘Arrowhead’, designing and iterating precision components to boost performance on the field.
